authorship: Independent manual paraphrases after reading authorized public contracts; not blinded or held-out from author. No model scores observed.

queries.text: An increasing list of distinct integers has been cyclically shifted. Find its least value in logarithmic time.

A list originally contained every integer from one through its length once. One entry was replaced by another, leaving a repeated value and a hole. Return the repeated value followed by the missing one.
Find the greatest number of adjacent entries that rise strictly from left to right in a nonempty integer list. Skipping entries is forbidden.
Transform a square zero-one picture by reflecting each row left to right and then exchanging every zero with one.

Apply nonoverlapping edits to a lowercase string at supplied original offsets. Each edit has an old fragment and a replacement. Only matching old fragments are replaced, and earlier edits must not move later offsets.

From a distinct list of lowercase words, return those that individually have enough copies of each letter to cover every word in a second list. The second-list words impose separate requirements, not a concatenated demand.
You must negate an entry of an integer array exactly k times, with repeated choices allowed. What is the largest total you can achieve?

Each domino shows one number above and one below. Swap the two sides of as few dominoes as possible so that either the upper row or lower row consists of one repeated number. Return minus one if impossible.
Find the longest nonempty block which can be repeated to produce each of two uppercase strings exactly. If there is no such block, return an empty string.

Evaluate a well-formed nested expression containing t and f literals and parenthesized prefix negation, conjunction, or disjunction; operands are comma separated. Negation has one operand and the others at least one.
Reorder an integer multiset using a second list of distinct preferred values as the group order. Append all unlisted values numerically sorted, preserving multiplicities.
Given lowercase candidate words and a bag of letters, add the lengths of all candidates that can each be assembled from the bag. Refill the bag before checking the next word.
For each query word, count how many supplied words have more occurrences of their own alphabetically first letter than the query has of its alphabetically first letter.
In a triangular table of integers, choose a route from the apex to the bottom with the smallest total. A step may go to either of the two adjacent entries immediately below.
An undirected graph has an independent success probability on each edge. Find the largest product along a route between two different specified vertices, or zero if no route connects them.

Guests arrive at distinct times and always take the lowest-numbered free chair starting at zero. A departing guest frees their chair before an arrival at the same moment. Which chair does a specified guest receive?
For each vertex of a directed acyclic graph, list all vertices that can reach it by at least one edge, without repeats and in ascending numerical order.
Choose one integer per row of a square grid to minimize the total. Start in any top-row column; each downward step stays in its column or shifts one column sideways.
Delete the same set of character positions from every equal-length lowercase string. Minimize deletions so that the list of remaining strings, without reordering the rows, is in dictionary order.

A binary tree stores integers zero through twenty-five as letters a through z. Among strings read from a leaf upward to the root, return the alphabetically earliest, with shorter prefixes ordered first.
Find the smallest sum on a path through rows of numbers.
Find the words that fit the available letters.
Find the longest increasing sequence.
Sort the data while respecting the specified order.
Return the indices of two array entries whose values add to a supplied target.
Implement a fixed-capacity cache that discards the least recently accessed key.
Will it rain here tomorrow afternoon?
Find the minimum in a rotated sorted array that may contain repeated values.
